advisories.description: Whatever is worth saying. An empty array is a valid and often correct answer.

kind.description: A word or two, in your own words, for what sort of remark this is. There is no fixed vocabulary and no severity scale — describe it however fits.

note.description: The remark itself, in one or two sentences.

claim.description: A stable one-sentence statement of the underlying concern. Reuse it if the same issue is reworded.

timing.description: When this concern matters. This is not a severity or verdict.

evidence_freshness.description: How fresh the evidence is. Use historical_context when it is only background.

why_it_matters.description: Why this is worth the reader's attention right now.

evidence.description: A concrete anchor if one applies: file:line, a command, an observed output. Empty string when the remark is a suggestion rather than a claim about existing code.

confidence.description: Your own confidence that this remark is correct and worth making.
